summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO spanning the Lantern March, reached through a realm menu and character creation, with a streamed open world plus separate dungeon and raid places. MMORPG Tools owns character, realm and UI lifecycle; ordered player behaviors compose movement, class combat, quests, trade, flight, vitality and regional music, while scenes and YAML registries provide world and story content.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - realm roster and Enter World/Create Hero front door.
places/character-creation-land/ - race, class and appearance selection with preview character and camera; arrivalBudget is 600000 bytes.

places/main/config.yaml and places/main/cells/ - Lantern March open world; streamed regions, hubs, campaigns and quest sources; the level 31–60 spine spans Velthraen Reach, Emberstone Bastion, Glassmere Archive and the Ninth Veil.
places/hollowcrypt/ - underground crypt campaign entered from Hollowcrypt Vale; halls, Archive, Candle Warden and paired gate; arrivalBudget is 620000 bytes.
places/drowned-bell/ - instanced Drowned Bell dungeon with themed halls, flood hazards, boss and paired entry/return gate.
places/root-archive/ - instanced Root Archive dungeon with themed halls, encounter props, boss and paired gates.
places/pale-choir/, places/emberheart/, places/ninth-assembly/ - themed raid places with encounter bosses and paired gates; endgame raid path branches through Pale Choir and Emberheart.
Instance configs use terrain off, gravity y=-24 and spawn (0,0.2,-4); shared layouts begin at z=0 and chambers proceed toward -Z.
roots: world.config.yaml - defaults to main-menu-land; binds player/camera templates, MMORPG UI, arrival redirect, routing and realm pulse.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/mod.json - registers MMORPG lifecycle, cameras, character/interaction behaviors and UI actions.
templates/player.js#player - ordered locomotion, movement, class, quest, vendor, trades, flight, vitality, cursor-free and region-music behaviors.
templates/camera.js#camera - gameplay camera; MMORPG owns separate menu and character-creation camera paths.
places/main/config.yaml - owns March terrain, regional surfaces/scatter and atmosphere; cell scenes bind local structures, quest interactables and NPCs.
places/{hollowcrypt,drowned-bell,root-archive,pale-choir,emberheart,ninth-assembly}/config.yaml - terrain/gravity/spawn environment for crypt and instance play.
places/main/cells/x-10z7.scene - Sorrowfen hub contains instance gates; each entrance pairs with an inside gate in its dungeon/raid scene.
mods/gavi/mod.json - registers Gavi crew behavior and panel, the builder-facing companion tools.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, persistence, currency and UI modules reused by MMORPG behaviors, gameplay scripts and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - character persistence, roster population, realm list and selected-realm detail shared by menu and player lifecycle.
scripts/lib/places.js - PLAY/isPlay and SAFE_HOME registry shared by quests, class actions, vitality and regional music; add any playable place here.
scripts/gen/instance.js - shared geometry/layout generator for all dungeon and raid places; scenes select layout and kind via params.
scripts/lib/data/quests.yml + MMORPG lib/quest-data.js - quest mechanics and lookup shared by quest-core, quest-giver and quest UI; prose is in quest-text.yml.
scripts/lib/data/bosses.yml + scripts/boss.js - encounter definitions and common boss behavior shared by placed dungeon, raid and open-world bosses.
scripts/lib/economy.js + MMORPG lib/currency.js - integer-copper transactions/ledger and denomination formatting shared by quests, vendor, flight, trade and UI.
scripts/lib/regions.js - regional IDs/name/radius definitions reused for zone presentation; ui-hud.js names areas and ui-zone-splash.js selects arrival art.
notableExports: scripts/lib/places.js - PLAY, isPlay, SAFE_HOME; scripts/gen/instance.js - LAYOUTS, roomsOf, geometry.
scripts/instance-gate.js - onTriggerEnter, onCross, onRefuse; scripts/boss.js - onSpawn, update for data-defined boss encounters.
MMORPG main-menu-mgr.js - getMenuRoster, getSelectedRosterIndex, hydrateMenuRoster, update, onSpawn, onInput; character-select.js - preview lifecycle and input/spawn handlers.
MMORPG ui.js - UI composition/actions; lib/version.js - GAME_VERSION, GAME_TITLE, versionTag (current GAME_VERSION 0.35.0 Alpha).
MMORPG lib/realm-save.js - realm list/detail refresh, roster persistence and realm metadata; lib/ui-main-menu.js - renderMainMenu.
MMORPG lib/ui-hud.js - renderTargetDisplay, renderHUD; scripts/player.js - onInput/update; scripts/vitality.js - scheduled fall/rise, mending and PvP zone/death handling.
scripts/quest-player.js - lightweight kill ear and deferred quest-core dispatch; scripts/quest-core.js - quest interaction/progression; lib/quest-text.js - qt, warm.
scripts/trades.js - lazy onInput/update door to trades-core; trades-core exports itemDef, band, onInput, update for gathering, professions and auction house.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.

MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots and persisted character records, including professions, inventory and quest state; realm-save patches realmList/realmDetail UI state.
main-menu-mgr.js - menu roster loading and selected roster slot; selection hydration prefers activeCharIdx, then selectedCharIdx, clamped to roster bounds.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js, pathfinder.js and shade.js - class action/cooldown/combat state; kit.js supplies common targeting/damage/drill helpers.
scripts/quest-core.js - quest interactions, progression, dialogue, inventory/cache/mark state and _questSave; quest-player.js kill ear updates player tally/XP and _questSave.
scripts/trades-core.js - per-player profession skills, gathering/crafting inventory mutations and tradeOpen/ahOpen UI state; gather-node.js reflects shared depletedUntil.
scripts/boss.js - placed boss hp/mode/cast/enrage/target-related fields; encounter clocks, damage attribution and target scratch live in boss ctx.session.
scripts/instance-gate.js - gate state.link/minLevel/entry quest tally configuration; on entry it stamps player's _worldEnterAt and conditionally increments tally.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → gameplay lifecycle.

Arrival outside main-menu-land without fresh _worldEnterAt or creation-place _creationEnterAt → scripts/arrival.js redirects to menu; menu and scripts/crypt-gate.js/instance-gate.js stamp allowed transitions.
main-menu-mgr loads current-room SQL roster; api.enterPlace routes selected character to saved place/position; routing validates requested room, then last room, then main.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml → scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js; cron writes room player count to realm_pulse, realm-save reads pulses and refreshes realmList/realmDetail.
Character creation race/class → lib/races.js start and character state → MMORPG player.js/realm-save upsert to characters keyed by user, realm and slot.

templates/player.js order → locomotion → movement → class handlers → quest-player → vendor → trades → flight → vitality → cursor-free → region-music; player.js/wow-move.js consume movement/camera intents.

First eligible quest-player input/update in any scripts/lib/places.js isPlay place → dynamic import quest-core; quests.yml + quest-data define mechanics, quest-text.js supplies prose, ui-quest renders it.
scripts/townsfolk.js uses local greet reach/cooldown constants; player-side scripts/quest-player.js reads townsfolk.yml for NPC talk, avoiding loading the quest book into resident places.

Main-place entrance gate (state.link, minLevel, enterQuest/enterTally) → instance-gate checks player/level and active quest, stamps _worldEnterAt and ctx.crosses to paired +place#gate; inside twin returns through its link.

Instance scenes bind scripts/gen/instance.js with layout/kind params; LAYOUTS and roomsOf produce shared themed room shells, corridors, floors and furnishings while scene placements supply encounters and props.

Boss scene state.boss → scripts/boss.js reads bosses.yml; arena entry wakes encounter, class scripts write hp/lastHitBy/lastHitAt, abilities telegraph then land, and empty arenas reset/leash; kill credits feed quest-player.
scripts/lib/regions.js regional IDs/names → ui-hud.js zone label and ui-zone-splash.js zone art; flights.yml roost region labels align to the new Velthraen, Glassmere and Bastion region names.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/instance.js - reused across instance places, varied by layout (room dimensions, corridor length, materials/colors) and kind (halls, pillar, brazier, dais, bell, organ, seat, rootcol); scene placements share layout coordinates.

scripts/boss.js + scripts/lib/data/bosses.yml - one AI across dungeon/raid and open-world placements, varied by boss definition: hp, arena, abilities/telegraphs, phases, enrage, rewards and sound/clips.

scripts/gen/ashen.js, scripts/gen/ashen-village.js and scripts/gen/grave-ground.js - Ashen Close graveyard, cathedral yard, gothic village pieces and consolidated graveyard cover; shape helpers, kind, seed, LOD and dimensions vary meshes/c…
scripts/gen/fen.js - procedural marsh props reused by Sorrowfen cells, varied by kind/seed/LOD; boardwalk geometry and collider share length/width/elevation parameters.
scripts/gen/tide.js - Tideglass structures and props share shape helpers; kind/LOD/length/width vary each piece.
scripts/gen/grove.js and scripts/gen/unseen.js - Deepgrove and Old Bond House structures/quest props reuse geometry/material helpers, varied by kind, seed and LOD.

scripts/grass.js, flower.js, mushroom.js, pebble.js and scripts/gen/tree.js + tree-look.js - terrain scatter and forest foliage recur across places, varied by layer density, scale, seed, tree kind and LOD.
scripts/gen/herb.js + scripts/gather-node.js - procedural herb clumps and node depletion/visibility shared across tagged Reach gatherables; params.kind and trades data vary the herb.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/grave-weeds.js - no scene or other package reference; graveyard cover is currently placed through grave-ground.js instead.
migrationNotes: Adding a playable place requires a row in scripts/lib/places.js PLAY; dying heroes rise at SAFE_HOME for listed dungeons/raids. Quest and class logic uses isPlay rather than hard-coded place names.

Instance room walls/corridors and scene furnishing placement share layout coordinates: entry is z=0, chambers chain toward -Z, floor y=0; keep scripts/gen/instance.js roomsOf arithmetic consistent with scenes.
Gate links are explicit +place#object links on paired gates; instance-gate checks minLevel and active enterQuest before crossing, stamps _worldEnterAt for arrival.js, and only then counts enterTally.

Bosses use shared hp/lastHitBy/lastHitAt fields written by class combat; boss.js emits kill to each hero's own behavior machine so quest-player owns tally/XP save. Boss behavior timing/damage attribution scratch belongs in ctx.session.
Money is one integer copper amount; 100 copper = 1 silver and 100 silver = 1 gold. Route transactions through scripts/lib/economy.js to preserve purse floor, ledger and UI feedback.

templates/player.js behavior order is significant; movement scratch is room-local ctx.session, scripts/player.js writes velocity while place config owns gravity, and cumulative xp remains distinct from xpInto/xpToLevel; levels.yml now anchors 31–60 through cap 60.
